description: This map displays satellite imagery, likely a false-colour composite (bands 1/2/3) from a Spot 5 sensor, depicting a terrestrial landscape at a 2.5 m resolution. The scene is dominated by land cover typical of semi-natural grassland, characterised by varying shades of brown, tan, and grey for bare soil or dry vegetation, interspersed with scattered reddish patches that indicate areas of denser vegetation or woody plants. A bright green winding line delineates a specific land cover boundary within the image. A small, bright green circular dot is marked within this outlined area, potentially representing a sampling point. A linear light blue feature, likely a stream or river, runs along part of the green boundary in the upper left portion of the map. This image is illustrative of mapping features for land cover classification within the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS), specifically related to semi-natural grasslands.
